$comment: The character in ONE place. The brain (backend/persona.py) and the page (frontend/src/persona.ts) both read this file. To change the character, edit it here: the avatar id (`character`), the names, the voice per language, and the dock's label per job (`roles`); then add the still photo the idle dock shows at frontend/src/characters/<character>.webp. To add a language, add a row to `languages` (and a greeting row in backend/persona.py's GREETINGS).
